messages:
morgan: FYI - we got a vendor alert for a medium-severity libcrypto vuln in our base images. I want to schedule a base-image rebuild + signing rotation this week. Needs RBAC checks, KMS rotation plan, and audit-log coverage.
jia: +1. can you share the vuln id? we should triage impact on pinned models / runtime containers first.
morgan: CVE-2026-2345 (vendor advisory). affects libcrypto in alpine:3.18-based images we ship to Dedicated. Attack surface is low but we need to be conservative for enterprise customers.
ryan: for signing, do we rotate cosign key in KMS or mint a new ephemeral key? ops preference?
anika: prefer KMS-backed key (HSM if available) with limited admin RBAC. create a new key, update image-signing pipeline, and deprecate old key after cutover. Need an RBAC PR so only sig-team + infra-deploy can use Encrypt/Sign.
jia: we also need to ensure audit logs capture: who triggered signing, which key id, image digest and build ID. retention 1y for enterprise customers.
morgan: agree. devops, please add these events to the centralized audit stream (auditd -> cloud-logging). include cosign output and build metadata.
ryan: quick note on rollout: canary to staging first, then 10% prod, monitor for runtime failures (OOMs, segfaults). fallback plan: auto-fallback to last-good signed image if healthcheck fails.
anika: security hardening checklist for rebuild: 1) drop CAP_NET_RAW, 2) add userns mapping (non-root default), 3) enable seccomp profile, 4) minimize layers + remove unneeded packages, 5) SBOM attached and cosigned.
morgan: adding runtime guardrail: orchestrator policy to block images without cosign attestation and SBOM except for a short mitigation window. update policy in OPA.
jia: about RBAC changes: we need a short-lived role for the build CI to sign images. propose role: image-signer-ci with kms:Sign and logs:Write limited to the signing project. Also a human sig-admin group for key rotation.
ryan: I'll draft the Terraform change and post PR. will also add an IAM condition to restrict signing to pipeline service account.
anika: incident response considerations: if we discover exploit in customer env, we need the ability to revoke keys or rotate quickly and force redeploys. add playbook steps in incident-runbook.md: rotate, push patch images, invalidate manifests.
morgan: add an automated query to detect running containers with vulnerable digest and notify owners. Can we run an image-scan job across Dedicated fleets?
jia: yes. I'll schedule a nightly scan and produce a report to #customer-success and alert owners with >=1 vulnerable container.
devsec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2026-0113 - base-image rebuild & key rotation - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-0113
ryan: sample cosign command for signers:
```
COSIGN_KMS=projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/cosign
cosign sign --key ksm://$COSIGN_KMS --bundle --output-signature image.tar
```
anika: please ensure build logs redact credentials and include key id in metadata. also check cosign bundle verification steps in runtime (kube admission).
morgan: timeline proposal: rebuild + sign in staging by EOD Thursday, canary Friday, full cutover Monday. anyone have conflicts?
jia: fine for me. ryan: I'll block the PR review Wednesday.
anika: I'll update the runbook and post a short tech note for Sales/CS about expected customer-facing impact.
morgan: thanks team. tagging @oncall for awareness. will follow up with PR links and the OPA policy diff.
